brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball news thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1792x1008 or another exact 16:9 size above 1000px wide. Make a new original editorial illustration, visibly hand-drawn and never photographic.

APPROVED ART DIRECTION: charcoal black #151A18 background, vivid lime #CCF43B dry brush sweeps, warm off-white heavyweight Japanese typography, expressive black-ink hatching and irregular brush edges. Restrained elements and strong hierarchy, like an ink sports editorial poster. Orange basketball as a prop, no floating ball-only concept. Flat printed colors and loose energetic ink, no glossy 3D or photoreal skin.

REAL PERSON (ONLY ONE PERSON): Keita Shinkawa / 新川敬大 of Fukushima Firebonds, current official roster #9. His name and number MUST NOT appear anywhere in the image. This is a real player selected randomly for an illustrative image, not the article's highlighted performer. I examined his official 2026-27 bust-up portrait at https://firebonds.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=1789014405/files/user/2026-27-FB-WEB-BUSTUP-9.jpg. Match these specific visible features: straight dense dark-brown hair with a rounded smooth crown, short close-cut sides, a fairly long side-swept fringe hanging diagonally across the forehead just above the eyes; long clean-shaven oval face with defined but gently tapered chin; relatively prominent ears; straight thick dark eyebrows; almond-shaped dark eyes, fairly straight nose with rounded tip, thin relaxed lips. No full beard, no moustache, no curly hair, no headband. Athletic shoulders and arms. Keep his actual recognizable facial features in expressive ink rendering, without inventing a generic different athlete. His official profile confirms left-handedness.

COMPOSITION: Reverse the usual text-left/player-right layout. The entire LEFT 43% features Shinkawa in a dynamic low driving dribble, torso leaned forward diagonally, head clearly visible in upper left, focused gaze angled into the court. His LEFT hand contacts the top/side of a basketball in mid-dribble near his left knee; right forearm bent naturally for balance. Three-quarter body to knees, anatomically plausible two arms and visible natural hands. The face, both hands, and complete basketball stay inside the image with safe margins. Plain off-white basketball jersey and shorts with black ink shading and a tiny muted-purple trim only. No jersey lettering, no team name, no number, no sponsor, no logo. This is a generic imagined movement of the real player, not a depiction or reconstruction of any actual game or scoring play. Abstract lime diagonal brush energy behind him, no other players or crowd faces, no actual arena.

TEXT AND LAYOUT: All article text occupies the RIGHT 53% over calm charcoal, not over the face or hands. At top, small brand text then date. Large bold Japanese headline. Beneath, a clear EFF information block; the pending qualification MUST clearly apply to EFF, not claim that no game has ended. Generous margins around every letter, readable Japanese at thumbnail size. Use ONLY these exact visible strings, each once:
"バスケまとめ"
"2026.11.04"
"B.ONE"
"試合結果"
"当日のEFF"
"全試合の公式記録確定待ち"
"19:54 JST時点"
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"イメージ"

Suggested hierarchy: top right バスケまとめ and 2026.11.04 modest; B.ONE small lime plain text; 試合結果 very large off-white; 当日のEFF medium large; 全試合の公式記録確定待ち on one or two neat lines with lime emphasis immediately under 当日のEFF; 19:54 JST時点 smaller directly below. Bottom footer across lower right, high contrast and clearly legible: イラスト（AI生成） | イメージ. These two annotations must remain separate exact strings (full-width parentheses in Japanese AI label).

SOURCE BOUNDARY: Copy comes exclusively from supplied frozen article source.html/source.txt. It states 2026-11-04 results as of 19:54 JST; B.ONE EFF listing waits for all games' official statistics. Some game results are already final. Do not add a score, statistics, standings, rankings, a TOP3 result, a victory claim, player appearance or performance claims, or a player name. No '成績をもとにしたイメージ' because this randomly selected player is not tied to those results. Do not use any photo pixels, team/league logos, sponsor words, or player name text. The full real-player action illustration is the visual protagonist. Deliver only a single finished thumbnail.

SINGLE CORRECTION
Edit image 1, the existing black-and-lime Japanese basketball thumbnail. Image 2 is the official photographic appearance reference for the ONE existing real basketball player, Keita Shinkawa (新川敬大). Use image 2 only to understand his actual face/hair; DO NOT paste any photographic pixels into the artwork and do not copy its logos, sponsors, jersey lettering, or backdrop.

This is the single allowed correction. Correct the face/likeness and character framing only. Preserve every existing Japanese text string, its spelling, size, position and the right-side composition exactly. Preserve the black #151A18 / lime #CCF43B palette and energetic expressive ink-and-brush illustration. Preserve the left-handed low dribble and orange basketball.

Likeness correction: image 1 currently looks like a generic younger manga athlete. Use the actual adult face from image 2 faithfully: smooth rounded straight dark-brown hair with a lower, heavier straight side-swept fringe and short close sides, not spiky windswept anime hair; relatively longer clean-shaven oval face, prominent rounded ears, actual almond eye shape and spacing, less stylized eyebrows, slightly wider rounded nose tip, subtle full lower lip and the actual tapered jaw/chin. Render him as a mature adult in editorial ink with recognizable proportions, no huge anime eyes and no angular heroic face. Keep focused expression. He is the exact real person in the official reference. Do not print his name or jersey number.

Framing correction: scale the illustrated player and his ball together down slightly, about 6%, and position inside the left illustration zone so the entire crown has at least 25 px of clear space to the top, the leftmost elbow has at least 20 px to the left edge, the whole ball and both hands remain fully inside with at least 25 px from edges. Natural crop of legs below thighs is fine. Preserve natural anatomy, five fingers on each visible hand, and contact between left hand and ball. Text is never covered.

Keep the plain white-and-purple-trim jersey with no marks, no names, no logo. Keep the exact text, including the EFF pending qualifier and both footer annotations:
